findings.title: Attack surface summary
findings.detail:
groups: open=0, allowlist=1
tools.elevated: enabled
hooks.webhooks: disabled
hooks.internal: enabled
browser control: enabled
trust model: personal assistant (one trusted operator boundary), not hostile multi-tenant on one shared gateway

findings.title: autoAllowSkills is enabled for exec approvals
findings.detail:
Implicit skill-bin allowlisting is enabled at:
- defaults.autoAllowSkills
This widens host exec trust beyond explicit manual allowlist entries.
findings.remediation: Disable autoAllowSkills in exec approvals and keep manual allowlists tight when you need explicit host-exec trust.

findings.title: HTTP API session-key override is enabled
findings.detail: /v1/chat/completions accept x-openclaw-session-key for per-request session routing. Treat API credential holders as trusted principals.

findings.title: Potential multi-user setup detected (personal-assistant model warning)
findings.detail:
Heuristic signals indicate this gateway may be reachable by multiple users:
- channels.telegram.groupPolicy="allowlist" with configured group targets
Runtime/process tools are exposed without full sandboxing in at least one context.
Potential high-impact tool exposure contexts:
- agents.defaults (sandbox=off; runtime=[exec, process]; fs=[read, write, edit, apply_patch]; fs.workspaceOnly=false)
- agents.list.main (sandbox=off; runtime=[exec, process]; fs=[read, write, edit, apply_patch]; fs.workspaceOnly=true)
- agents.list.moneypenny (sandbox=off; runtime=[exec, process]; fs=[read, write, edit, apply_patch]; fs.workspaceOnly=true)
- agents.list.octopussy (sandbox=off; runtime=[exec, process]; fs=[read, write, edit, apply_patch]; fs.workspaceOnly=true)
- agents.list.towelie (sandbox=off; runtime=[exec, process]; fs=[read, write, edit, apply_patch]; fs.workspaceOnly=true)
- agents.list.Felix-The_Messenger (sandbox=off; runtime=[exec, process]; fs=[read, write, edit, apply_patch]; fs.workspaceOnly=true)
- agents.list.cryptobot (sandbox=off; runtime=[exec, process]; fs=[read, write, edit, apply_patch]; fs.workspaceOnly=true)
- agents.list.vesper (sandbox=off; runtime=[exec, process]; fs=[read, write, edit, apply_patch]; fs.workspaceOnly=true)
- agents.list.drax (sandbox=off; runtime=[exec, process]; fs=[read, write, edit, apply_patch]; fs.workspaceOnly=true)
- agents.list.nomi (sandbox=off; runtime=[exec, process]; fs=[read, write, edit, apply_patch]; fs.workspaceOnly=true)
- agents.list.scaramanga (sandbox=off; runtime=[exec, process]; fs=[read, write, edit, apply_patch]; fs.workspaceOnly=true)
- agents.list.zorin (sandbox=off; runtime=[exec, process]; fs=[read, write, edit, apply_patch]; fs.workspaceOnly=true)
- agents.list.moat (sandbox=off; runtime=[exec, process]; fs=[read, write, edit, apply_patch]; fs.workspaceOnly=true)
OpenClaw's default security model is personal-assistant (one trusted operator boundary), not hostile multi-tenant isolation on one shared gateway.
findings.remediation: If users may be mutually untrusted, split trust boundaries (separate gateways + credentials, ideally separate OS users/hosts). If you intentionally run shared-user access, set agents.defaults.sandbox.mode="all", keep tools.fs.workspaceOnly=true, deny runtime/fs/web tools unless required, and keep personal/private identities + credentials off that runtime.
